description:
[Caught Between Puppy Love and Libido, Muscles and Appetite: Nam Noeul and the Idiots]

Nam Noeul wants nothing more than to finally seal the deal with Baek Sol, and as soon as possible.
But Baek Sol refuses to believe that Noeul bulked up overnight, the younger brother who could prove his innocence will not listen, rivals who like Baek Sol keep multiplying, and on top of that, someone even suggests Noeul should just give up on Baek Sol and date them instead.

Torn between pure romance and raw desire, between muscles and appetite, can Nam Noeul and his band of idiots navigate their increasingly tangled relationships and still achieve what they want?

---
